## Description
Provide a concise overview of what this pull request modifies, adds, or resolves.

## Motivation & Context
Why is this change required? What problem does it solve or feature does it introduce?
If it fixes an open issue, link it here (e.g. `Fixes #1`).

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 💄 UI / Styling enhancement (visual polish or design update)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (README, comments, changelog)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement (optimizations, canvas rendering)
- [ ] 🔧 Build / Configuration update (.gitignore, build scripts)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding conventions and formatting style.
- [ ] I have tested these changes across supported browsers or target environments.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) if applicable.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or console errors.
